notes: Curated from feat/sdlc-skill-expansion chat: help, SkillOpt-on-init (no npm task), PR evidence, docs, hygiene, operations. Evidence task split into train+val so reflection can fire on train failures.

tasks.intent: The user says: sdlc help. What do you do? List the exact first actions and which subcommands you mention.
tasks.context_excerpt: User wants usage help for the Epoch SDLC skill router, not product implementation.
tasks.attempted_solution: Previously agents started product work instead of printing usage.
tasks.reference: Print usage from help.md and stop; mention help, finish, clean, review, docs, skills, init

tasks.intent: How should Microsoft SkillOpt be installed for Epoch agents? Should there be an npm run agents:install-skillopt script?
tasks.context_excerpt: User rejected a standing npm task; install is once on sdlc init via node scripts/install-skillopt.mjs.
tasks.attempted_solution: Agent added npm run agents:install-skillopt scripts.
tasks.reference: Install once via sdlc init / node scripts/install-skillopt.mjs; no npm task

tasks.intent: Before squash-merging a persona-visible feature PR, what evidence must appear on the GitHub PR, and where is the pack stored?
tasks.context_excerpt: SDLC requires docs/evidence pack plus visible PR ## SDLC evidence section.
tasks.attempted_solution: Mentioned sticky comment only; omitted docs/evidence path.
tasks.reference: docs/evidence/<slug>/ plus ## SDLC evidence body + sticky comment

tasks.intent: Reviewer asks: where is the evidence pack stored, and what heading must the PR show?
tasks.context_excerpt: Held-out paraphrase of PR evidence requirements.
tasks.attempted_solution: Mentioned sticky comment only; omitted docs/evidence path.

tasks.intent: A layer changed CLI flags. Which sdlc command do you run for documentation, and what gate proves links/orphans are OK?
tasks.context_excerpt: Documentation must follow freshness matrix in the same PR.
tasks.attempted_solution: Docs deferred to a follow-up PR with no justification.
tasks.reference: sdlc docs --fix and npm run docs:check

tasks.intent: An implementer wants a new packages/Epoch.TinyHelper package for a 40-line utility used by one module. What does sdlc say?
tasks.context_excerpt: Repo hygiene: extend existing modules; avoid file/folder explosion.
tasks.attempted_solution: Created a new package for a thin helper.
tasks.reference: Reject new package; extend existing module; high cohesion

tasks.intent: Stack layers are squash-merged. How do you clean session branches and worktrees safely?
tasks.context_excerpt: Parent owns cleanup after merge; merged-only by default.
tasks.attempted_solution: git clean -fdx and deleted unrelated user branches.

tasks.intent: Should Epoch use lean-skillopt community forks or Microsoft SkillOpt for skill evolution?
tasks.reference: Prefer microsoft/SkillOpt; do not prefer lean forks

tasks.intent: For new user-visible Community API boundary work, which test mix does sdlc require by default?
tasks.context_excerpt: New work: persona Gherkin + Playwright driver + Pact; no new full-stack e2e by default.
tasks.attempted_solution: Added a new full-stack e2e suite by default.
tasks.reference: Gherkin + Playwright + Pact; no new full-stack e2e by default

tasks.intent: User says /sdlc finish with uncommitted skill work on feat/sdlc-skill-expansion. What do you do, and do you ask again before squash-merge?
tasks.context_excerpt: finish.md: finish is authorization to push, PR, and squash-merge; billing-red CI does not block.
tasks.attempted_solution: Stopped after opening a PR and waited for human merge approval.
tasks.reference: Run finish protocol to squash-merge; do not re-ask for merge permission

checks.arg: (?i)(do not re-ask|without re-asking|authorization|authorized|do not ask again)

tasks.intent: What command must implementers run before every commit in Epoch? Is it pnpm agent:check?
tasks.context_excerpt: Epoch uses npm run gate:commit; never instruct pnpm agent:check.
tasks.attempted_solution: Told the subagent to run pnpm agent:check -- --staged.
tasks.reference: npm run gate:commit; not pnpm agent:check
